prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / style-transfer.
Asset: one existing installed Feudal Lord Simulator game image; non-destructive Wave41 revision.
Input1 is the immutable geometry reference. Edit this image, do not design a different asset.
Replace the modern striped traffic barrier cue with a medieval toll-way marker in the same silhouette and spatial footprint: rough oak upright and crosspiece, no red-white stripes, no metal traffic mechanism. Convey medieval passage/toll, no letters or extra external objects.
ART_BIBLE_v2: soft hand-painted prerender, muted southern English1300-1450 material palette, upper-left world lighting, no black cartoon outline, no added text/watermark.
Maintain EXACT original canvas aspect 96:96, original transparent padding, anchor/pivot, ground contact, silhouette, perspective and occupied bounds. Do not crop, recenter or rotate. Output exactly one image; no comparison sheet.
Genuine transparent background. All originally empty regions remain transparent.
Input1 exact immutable geometry; input2 ONLY subdued oak material style. Change the diagonal red-and-white striped barrier arm into unpainted weathered oak, same angle and length, no stripe pattern. Preserve the ORIGINAL small gold coin at lower-right, pillar, foot, brace and round hinge position exactly; do not add any new coins or objects. At the hinge use dark simple iron/wood fastening without a modern traffic machine. Do not alter underlying outline. Geometry is an existing toll icon being resurfaced, NOT a redesigned scene. Keep all original transparent negative spaces.

inspection.native_size: Viewed final native-size and4x nearest side-by-side proof
inspection.geometry: Final alpha channel byte-identical to immutable runtime reference; exact canvas and alpha silhouette preserved by explicit postprocess; raw generation alone did not meet exact pixel geometry
inspection.content: No red-white traffic stripe, warm oak beam, original coin RGB preserved.
inspection.limitations: Offline candidate only; not installed, CSS/world rendering not run by this lane.

postprocessing.canvas_resize: single Lanczos3 full-canvas resize, no crop/trim/recenter
postprocessing.color_extension: Generated RGB nearest valid opaque sample extended only into original-alpha edge pixels where generated alpha<180; no original geometry moved
postprocessing.additional_surface_registration: Preserved original coin RGB in x31..66,y60..95 because coin not an edit target. Original alpha unchanged.
